name: That's What the Coin Said
source:
Play as Miller and march into the unknown on a halloween night. unaware of what might wait for you and your friends in the darkness.

[From [url=https://taler.itch.io/twtcs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演米勒，在万圣节之夜迈向未知吧——你浑然不知黑暗深处究竟有什么正等待着你与朋友们。

[摘自[url=https://taler.itch.io/twtcs]itch.io[/url]]
